_comment: محرران للاستيفاء في هذا الملف. (1) وقت التوليد: العلامات مثل Audio Tools هي عناصر نائبة بأحرف كبيرة وفواصل تحت السطر يستبدلها `vrooli scenario generate` قبل بناء السيناريو، فتظهر في وقت التشغيل كقيم عرض حرفية. (2) وقت التشغيل: العلامات مثل {{count}} هي استيفاء i18next يُستبدل عند التصيير عبر `t(key, { count })`. المفاتيح التي تبدأ بشرطة سفلية (مثل هذا المفتاح) عناصر حارسة — يتجاهلها مولّد الكود واختبار التطابق وتدقيق المفاتيح غير المستخدمة.

app.title: Audio Tools
app.description: قدرات صوتية مشتركة — تحويل الكلام إلى نص، تحويل النص إلى كلام، التلخيص، إعادة الترميز — مع توجيه المزود BYOK / Vrooli / Local.

speakerAdmin.pageDescription: Manage enrolled speaker profiles and verification mode for the STT pipeline.
speakerAdmin.extractionHelp: Isolate the enrolled speaker's voice before transcription — removes overlapping voices. Needs an enrolled profile and verification enabled; adds a little latency per utterance.
speakerAdmin.thresholdHelp: Score required for a transcript to pass (0–1).
speakerAdmin.enrollHint: Record 3–5 clips in different conditions (devices, normal vs. whisper). Each clip is appended to the profile to strengthen it.
speakerAdmin.enrollClipLabelHelp: Condition for this clip, e.g. laptop-normal or phone-whisper.
speakerAdmin.enrollActivate: Activate and enable verification after the first clip

wakeWordAdmin.pageDescription: Manage the wake-word template used by the streaming STT pipeline.
wakeWordAdmin.noTemplate: No wake-word template is currently configured.
wakeWordAdmin.thresholdHelp: Higher values require a closer match (0.10–0.95).
wakeWordAdmin.samplesHelp: Record between 3 and 5 samples of the wake word. Speak the phrase the same way each time.
wakeWordAdmin.needMinSamples: Record at least {{min}} samples before saving.

streamConfigAdmin.pageDescription: Tune the streaming STT pipeline parameters.
streamConfigAdmin.enginesHelp: Select which engine the local streaming pipeline uses. Unavailable engines cannot be selected until their backing resource is reachable.
streamConfigAdmin.switchSafeToStop: No other scenario uses {{resource}}. You can stop it to reclaim compute — audio-tools will never stop it for you.
streamConfigAdmin.switchConsumersHeader: These scenarios still use {{resource}}; we recommend leaving it running:
streamConfigAdmin.switchConsumersUnknown: Other consumers of {{resource}} could not be enumerated, so we can't recommend stopping it.
streamConfigAdmin.switchNoResource: This engine has no local backing resource to manage.
streamConfigAdmin.stopCommandLabel: Stop command (run manually if you choose)
streamConfigAdmin.stopCommandHintConsumers: If you still want to stop it:
streamConfigAdmin.overlapHelp: Overlap-Agree force-commits its longest stable prefix after this many consecutive divergence-rejected commit attempts, preventing the sliding window from blowing up. 0 disables the guard; 3 is the default.
streamConfigAdmin.stallRejectsDisabled: Guard disabled — Overlap-Agree may stall on persistently divergent audio.
streamConfigAdmin.overlapError: Could not update the stall guard.
streamConfigAdmin.overlapLoadError: Could not load the stream config.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Provider routing, BYOK credentials, and effective environment overrides.
config.providerRoutingDescription: Per-capability tier enablement. Precedence is BYOK → Vrooli → Local. ErrInsufficientCredits short-circuits.
config.byokCredsDescription: Provider-keyed API credentials. Stored locally; displayed as fingerprint only.
config.byokEmpty: No BYOK credentials configured. The audio-tools API will use Vrooli + Local tiers per provider config.
config.envDescription: Read-only view of the effective env vars the API uses.
config.envFollowUp: Live env-resolution lands once SettingsService.GetEnvOverrides ships.

voices.localHealthFollowUp: Live probes land once SettingsService.ListLocalResourceHealth ships.

diagnostics.description: Send a manual call and observe the provider trace. Verifies BYOK → Vrooli → Local routing end-to-end.
diagnostics.transcribeDescription: Upload an audio file (mp3/wav/flac/aac/ogg). Routed via the STT provider chain.
diagnostics.summarizeDescription: Send free-form text through the summarization chain.
diagnostics.synthesizeDescription: Render text through the TTS provider chain and return audio bytes.
diagnostics.transcodeDescription: Convert between audio formats via the local audio service.
diagnostics.traceDescription: Most-recent calls and which tier handled them.
diagnostics.traceEmpty: Run a diagnostic to populate the trace. The tier, provider, model, and latency appear here per call.
diagnostics.oneshotHint: Records a short clip, then uploads via multipart REST to exercise the unary STT chain.
